ADS301 dashboard calibration — replacement for old calibration controls
info:
Use the Dashboard in this order:
1. Select Silo 1 or Silo 2.
2. Ensure selected silo is empty and stable, then press Set Zero.
3. Add a stable, known test load.
4. Enter that exact load in kg and press Calibrate Known Weight + Save.

Each command is held to one per second, routes to the correct TCP Modbus server,
and writes with Unit ID 1. Do not use the old dashboard calibration controls after importing.

info:
This replacement is for two ADS301 boxes on one RS-485 bus using the existing mbusd-weight-port-3 client.

Logical identity is independent of Modbus address:
Silo 1 always publishes <gateway>_silo_01
Silo 2 always publishes <gateway>_silo_02

IMPORTANT ADDRESSING PROCEDURE:
If both boxes currently have the same Modbus address, physically isolate one box from the RS-485 bus before assigning a new address. Shared 24 V power may remain, but disconnect the target/non-target RA, RB and GND as appropriate so only one device can answer.

The address-assignment tool changes the address of the currently addressed ADS301 channel and saves it with TDD=1. For this project it is intended to address the master/total-weight channel used at MSV register 40. It does not automatically renumber every internal slave channel.

Addressing instructions
format:
Commissioning — assign and map the two ADS301 addresses
Both junction boxes share one RS-485 cable, so they must use different Modbus addresses.

Normal example: Silo 1 = Unit 1; Silo 2 = Unit 12.
If both boxes currently use the same address, disconnect one box from RA/RB before changing the other. Only one ADS301 may answer at the current address.

Assign new address changes the ADS301 itself. Apply Silo-to-Unit mapping tells Node-RED which address belongs to Silo 1 and Silo 2.

name: Calibration instructions
format:
Calibration — completed in two separate visits if required
1. Empty silo: select the silo, make sure it is empty and stable, then press Set Zero. The completion time is recorded below.

2. Later, with a known load: select the same silo, type the exact known weight, wait for the load to stabilise, then press Calibrate Known Weight + Save.

Do not press Set Zero while the silo contains feed. The zero timestamp confirms which silo was zeroed and when the ADS301 acknowledged the final zero command.
